parsed.note_claim: The extended ISS stay for Sunita Williams and Butch Wilmore was due to helium leaks and problems with the spacecraft's maneuvering thrusters on the Boeing Starliner.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: NASA and Boeing identified helium leaks and experienced issues with the spacecraft reaction control thrusters on June 6 as Starliner approached the space station.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly confirms the technical issues (helium leaks and thrusters) that led to the decision to return Starliner uncrewed and extend the astronauts' stay.
